summary: The visual language is broadly on target and the room achieves bleak hierarchy, but mandatory reverse navigation and several hero camera gates fail from excessive darkness; the cart frame is unusable as visual evidence.

categories.name: Layout / route readability
categories.reason: The preserved compact room reads as a central circulation strip between the OCRU bay and recovery/workbench wall. Entry and rescue-route views preserve functional grouping and open floor; the dark entry door limits reverse navigation clarity, without evidence of a changed room boundary.

categories.name: Art direction / silhouettes
categories.reason: Authored bed rail, lift, layered monitor housing, guarded switch, cartridge dock, folded basin and clinical-prop forms meet the grounded stylized direction in the views where they are visible. No dominant repeated-bevel-box, low-poly toy, decorative sci-fi or texture-noise veto is present. The bag remains overly flat and rigid in its inspection view.

categories.name: Hero objects / focal clarity
categories.reason: The red berth is the clear room focal point and the restart station is readable. The cart cannot be assessed from its nearly black required frame; OCRU side interfaces, reserve-power assembly and the right cabinet leaf lose sufficient form and material detail to block their hero gates.

categories.name: Materials / anti-plastic
categories.reason: Visible clinical linen, dark gloves, paper, painted blue/red housings, steel rails, tiles and glass have distinct broad responses. Most major assets avoid generic gloss. Shadow suppresses separation in several functional assemblies; the hidden bag top and straight edge bands read rigid despite the visible zipper and handles.

categories.name: Lighting / atmosphere
categories.reason: Single red bed practical, warm workbench light and restrained cool working-zone emphasis establish bleak hierarchy. Several required focal views exceed useful darkness: entry construction and side interfaces vanish, reserve power is displaced by adjacent brightness, and the transfer-cart frame is essentially unreadable. Darkness/possible occlusion is not evidence of acceptable asset fidelity.

categories.name: Dressing / worldbuilding
categories.reason: The denied-release shift log, continuity graphic, sparse procedure signage, clinical working props and localized wash-area decline support institutional hopelessness without random clutter. The tiny note stays unobtrusive and a closed zipper/handles are confirmed under inspection fill. Bag fabric refinement would strengthen the concealed story object.

technical_score.reason: Visual critic only. No technical cleanliness, measured clearance, support-contact, cold-start, reproducibility or runtime result is inferred.

hard_style_veto.comment: No dominant style veto is claimed. Unreadable required evidence and functional hero silhouettes still block visual acceptance.

defects.finding: The required transfer-cart subject is essentially unavailable in the black render.
defects.repair: Diagnose fixed-camera occlusion versus light reach in a disposable process; restore a minimal readable cart silhouette and material/construction read while preserving the established mood. Rerender the same fixed view.
defects.limit: No visual judgment of cart fidelity or support is possible from this frame; this does not establish the technical cause.

defects.region: Centre entry door/header; REVERSE x335–637/y178–414; WALL_SOUTH x325–638/y195–464
defects.finding: Door leaves, frame relationship and institutional identification disappear into black.
defects.repair: Use restrained reflected/edge fill on the entry leaf and frame so destination and construction read; retain the red and warm practical hierarchy, without a global exposure increase.
defects.limit: Rendered clarity is assessed; no route width or collision clearance is certified.

defects.region: OCRU side interfaces; reserve assembly x212–727/y118–555; right cabinet leaf x468–780/y56–377
defects.finding: Functional hero construction and material families fall below a useful readable value.
defects.repair: Control existing local spill/reflection to reveal each housing/shelf/glass edge and its working silhouette. Preserve black negative space around these objects and keep the bed the brightest red focal cue.
defects.limit: The visible problem is readability. Construction hidden by darkness cannot be scored as either well-built or primitive.

defects.region: Bag top and edge bands, approximately x41–1027/y253–486
defects.finding: The zip and handles prove a closed bag, but the broad flat surface and straight bands resemble a rigid carrier pad/tray.
defects.repair: Add restrained broad fabric slack/tension, softened corners and irregular thickness appropriate to a folded closed bag; keep it concealed and avoid a noisy grunge treatment.
defects.limit: No corpse or filled-body silhouette is required by this review; the defect concerns bag material/construction read.

per_camera.label: 01 | FRONT LEFT / CUTAWAY
per_camera.observation: Overall route, OCRU mass and clinical wall are organized with useful negative space. Cutaway presentation does not prove player-camera detail or physical support.

per_camera.label: 02 | FRONT RIGHT / CUTAWAY
per_camera.observation: Bed bay, recovery berth, console, cartridge bank and decon are functionally grouped. Unlit skin regions remain an issue in closer designated views.

per_camera.label: 03 | REAR LEFT / CUTAWAY
per_camera.observation: The fixed layout and central movement strip are visually coherent. Dark entrance detail is separately failed in the entry-wall and reverse views.

per_camera.label: 04 | REAR RIGHT / CUTAWAY
per_camera.observation: Opposing overview preserves functional grouping and floor route. Small asset/support details cannot be validated at this framing.

per_camera.label: 05 | ENTRY WALL
per_camera.observation: Centre entry leaf and header, approximately x325–638/y195–464, are near black; sign, seal/leaf construction and useful material identity cannot be read.

per_camera.label: 06 | OCRU WALL
per_camera.observation: Red berth and mechanical lifts read, but both side interaction housings and much of the structural frame lose secondary form into black.

per_camera.label: 07 | RESTART / DECON WALL
per_camera.observation: Restart, cartridge rack and decon grouping remain readable with differentiated construction. Recovery edge stays subordinate.

per_camera.label: 08 | RECOVERY / SUPPLIES WALL
per_camera.observation: Recovery, wash and warm supply worktop remain distinct overall functions. Cabinet and underbench detail are dark; cabinet has its own failed hero gate.

per_camera.label: 09 | OCRU REANIMATION UNIT
per_camera.observation: Bed seams, rails and lifts are specific; INSERT/RELEASE left x45–202/y205–465 and SUIT right x844–988/y267–491 are near-black masses, impairing interaction and material read.

per_camera.label: 10 | RESTART CONSOLE
per_camera.observation: Layered monitor bezels, guarded controls, drawer hardware, folded shelf trim and restrained color hierarchy are readable; interface is functional rather than emissive filler.

per_camera.label: 11 | MEDICAL CARTRIDGE BANK
per_camera.observation: Docked cartridges, shelf divisions, frame fasteners and labels support purposeful manufacturing. Functional repetition does not become generic unrelated-box repetition.

per_camera.label: 12 | RESERVE POWER
per_camera.observation: Hero region x212–727/y118–555 is mostly black while adjacent console is bright; battery casing, connections and shelf depth cannot be confidently read.

per_camera.label: 13 | DECONTAMINATION ALCOVE
per_camera.observation: Reel, sagging hose, wall-service termination, bin/pedal and slatted floor read as a practical narrow service alcove.

per_camera.label: 14 | RECOVERY BERTH
per_camera.observation: Broad linen folds/thickness separate from tubular rails and frame; tiny note at foot stays barely visible. Dark lower structure limits microdetail but does not erase the berth.

per_camera.label: 15 | TRANSFER CART
per_camera.observation: Entire scene region above the review label is essentially black. Cart silhouette, construction, support and material response are unavailable from the actual pixels. Cause may be illumination or camera occlusion; this review does not infer it.

per_camera.label: 16 | SUPPLY WORKBENCH
per_camera.observation: Warm working surface and restrained prop cluster communicate clinical function. Lower storage/legs lose detail, a secondary concern rather than a missing whole focal subject.

per_camera.label: 17 | HANDWASH STATION
per_camera.observation: Folded basin/rim, tap, molded dispenser and local wall deterioration remain distinct from the bright adjacent worktop. Hidden waste/support geometry is not certified.

per_camera.label: 18 | MEDICAL SUPPLIES CABINET
per_camera.observation: Left glazing and supplies retain a partial read; right leaf/interior around x468–780/y56–377 falls into black, preventing a full cabinet material/construction assessment.

per_camera.label: 19 | ENTRY / PLAYER HEIGHT
per_camera.observation: Red OCRU, rear working station and right recovery silhouette establish the room at player height; central route remains readable. Local detail failures are real but do not erase the entry composition.

per_camera.label: 20 | REVERSE / PLAYER HEIGHT
per_camera.observation: Entry door centre, approximately x335–637/y178–414, loses opening/leaf construction and material cues into black. Warm left and red right focal pools leave the destination too weak.

per_camera.label: 21 | RESCUE ROUTE / PLAYER HEIGHT
per_camera.observation: Rear console, cartridges and decon entry retain clear hierarchy and usable negative floor space. Geometric clearance remains a separate numerical check.

per_camera.label: 22 | OCRU CARRIAGE / DETAIL
per_camera.observation: Upholstery seams, shaped pillow, telescoped rail/sleeves, lift blocks, restrained bolts and chassis layers demonstrate authored construction and material separation.

per_camera.label: 23 | CLINICAL WORK / DETAIL
per_camera.observation: Specific tools, folded linen, bandages, gloves, bottle construction and denied-release log support tactile clinical work without noise or random clutter.

per_camera.label: 24 | BAG / INSPECTION FILL
per_camera.observation: Closed zipper, teeth/pull and handles are visibly confirmed. The broad flat top, straight blue edge bands and crossing strips need softer bag-specific slack/tension; inspection fill is not gameplay lighting evidence.

practical_limits: Only current cycle-8 pixels and approved spawn calibration were reviewed; no historical critic scores or implementation were read.
Cutaways intentionally expose interiors and cannot establish physical support, room boundary measurements or player clearances.
HIDDEN_BAG uses labelled inspection fill, so its material/shape evidence does not certify bag visibility under gameplay lighting.
No calibrated luminance threshold was imposed; regions and coordinates describe qualitative visual failures in the supplied render.
Final-two-cycle stability, cold-start, engine import and owner acceptance remain unreviewed.
repair_order: V8-01: recover the required transfer-cart image.
V8-02: reveal destination construction in REVERSE and WALL_SOUTH.
V8-03: restore minimal form/material cues on OCRU side interfaces, reserve power and cabinet right leaf.
V8-04: refine bag fabric, preserving concealment.
completion_statement: Visual acceptance is blocked. Re-evaluate the same 24 fixed views after repairs; no technical or overall 100-point pass is awarded.
